fields.headline: Quantum computing — flashcards
fields.summary: Three cards on the vocabulary every explainer assumes you already know. Open a card to check yourself.

cards.question: What is a qubit?
cards.answer: The quantum unit of information. Unlike a bit it can hold a superposition of 0 and 1, and only collapses to one of them when measured.

cards.question: What does quantum entanglement mean?
cards.answer: Two or more qubits share a single state, so measuring one instantly fixes the outcome of the others — however far apart they are.

cards.question: Why does a quantum computer need error correction?
cards.answer: Physical qubits decohere in microseconds. Many of them are combined into one logical qubit whose errors can be detected and corrected faster than they accumulate.
